description: This file is a shell script that provides utility functions to control prplMesh processes, handle configurations, manage logs, and manipulate ODL parameters related to the prplMesh ecosystem.

methods.name: send_signal_to_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Sends a specified signal to a prplMesh process identified by its program name.

methods.name: start_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Starts a prplMesh process by program name.

methods.name: stop_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Stops a prplMesh process gracefully, and kills it if necessary after a timeout.

methods.name: roll_logs_function
methods.description: Handles log rotation for prplMesh components by managing log files and sending SIGHUP signals.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: odl_get_str_param
methods.description: Extracts the value of a specified parameter from ODL files.

methods.name: odl_set_param
methods.description: Sets or updates a specified parameter in ODL files, supporting string and boolean types.

methods.name: ensure_platform_db
methods.description: Ensures the prplMesh platform database file exists in a temporary directory.

methods.name: certification_mode_to_num
methods.description: Converts human-readable certification mode to numerical representation.

methods.name: set_management_and_certification_mode
methods.description: Configures management and certification modes by updating internal parameters and files.

methods.name: start_func
methods.description: Starts prplMesh core processes based on mode and configuration.

methods.name: stop_func
methods.description: Stops all prplMesh core processes gracefully.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses arguments and controls the script flow for starting, stopping, restarting, checking status, or rolling logs of prplMesh components.
